verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing site says you can schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep data fresh, with refreshes as often as every minute. That covers the core of recurring scheduled jobs. However, the evidence comes only from homepage marketing copy; no API, SDK or MCP documentation shows how schedules are created or managed. Missing for 10: documented scheduling configuration (cron/interval options), programmatic or agent-driven schedule creation via API/SDK/MCP, schedule management (pause/edit/list), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
